title: PokeUs
description: Relationship & couple engagement platform with challenges, games, and shared experiences.
longDescription: PokeUs is a full-stack relationship engagement platform designed to help couples stay connected through interactive challenges, mini-games, shared experiences, and real-time activities. Built with a product-first mindset, it focuses on emotional engagement and delightful UX.
problemStatement: Couples often struggle to maintain meaningful engagement in long-distance or busy lifestyles. PokeUs solves this by creating a dedicated digital space for shared activities and emotional connection.
architecture: Next.js frontend with API routes, real-time features via WebSockets, MongoDB for user data and activity logs, and a modular component architecture for scalable feature additions.
challenges: Designing engaging UX for two-user flows
learnings: Product thinking beyond code — user retention through gamification

title: Bondly
description: Modern relationship companion app with shared moments and connection features.
longDescription: Bondly is a TypeScript-powered web application focused on helping people nurture relationships through thoughtful interactions, shared content, and a polished modern interface.
problemStatement: Digital tools for relationships often feel generic. Bondly provides a purpose-built experience with modern design patterns.
architecture: React SPA architecture deployed on Vercel with component-driven development and Tailwind for consistent styling.

title: Weather Wizard (MausamSathi)
description: Beautiful weather forecast app with geolocation, dark mode, and animated weather visuals.
longDescription: MausamSathi (Weather Wizard) delivers real-time weather data with an emphasis on visual design — animated weather states, geolocation support, and a seamless dark/light experience.
problemStatement: Most weather apps prioritize data over experience. Weather Wizard combines accurate forecasts with delightful animations.
architecture: React frontend consuming OpenWeather API with responsive CSS animations and local storage for theme preferences.

title: HeyBuddy Sports App
description: Sports teammate finder app connecting players for local games and activities.
longDescription: HeyBuddy helps sports enthusiasts find teammates for local games. Built with TypeScript and modern React patterns, it streamlines the process of organizing pickup games and finding players nearby.
problemStatement: Finding reliable teammates for casual sports is fragmented across group chats and social media.
architecture: Next.js application with server-side rendering for SEO and fast initial loads.

title: Speech Emotion Detector
description: AI-powered voice analysis tool that detects emotions from speech with analytics dashboard.
longDescription: An AI-driven application that analyzes voice input to detect emotional states. Features real-time processing, emotion classification, and a dashboard for analytics visualization.
problemStatement: Understanding emotional context in voice communication requires specialized tools beyond text analysis.
architecture: Python ML backend for emotion classification, React frontend for visualization, REST API communication layer.
learnings: Integrating ML models into web apps

title: ApnaStore
description: Full-featured e-commerce store with product catalog, cart, and checkout flow.
longDescription: ApnaStore is a complete e-commerce web application demonstrating full-stack JavaScript development with product management, shopping cart, and user-friendly checkout.
problemStatement: Learning e-commerce patterns requires building end-to-end shopping experiences.
architecture: MERN stack with React frontend and Node.js/Express API backend.

title: Video Conferencing
description: Real-time video conferencing platform with room-based meetings.
longDescription: A WebRTC-powered video conferencing application enabling real-time communication with room creation, screen sharing capabilities, and a clean meeting interface.
problemStatement: Remote collaboration needs lightweight, accessible video tools.
architecture: WebRTC peer connections with Socket.io signaling server.

title: Dinacharya
description: Daily routine and habit tracking application for structured lifestyle management.
longDescription: Dinacharya helps users build and maintain daily routines with habit tracking, progress visualization, and motivational streaks.
problemStatement: Consistent daily habits are hard to maintain without visual progress tracking.
architecture: React SPA with local storage persistence and responsive design.

title: Store Rating Platform
description: Platform for rating and reviewing local stores with user-generated content.
longDescription: A community-driven store rating platform where users can discover, rate, and review local businesses.
problemStatement: Local store discovery lacks a centralized rating system.
architecture: Full-stack JavaScript with MySQL relational database.

title: Real Estate Web App
description: Property listing platform with search, filters, and detailed property views.
longDescription: A real estate web application showcasing property listings with advanced search, filtering by price/location, and detailed property pages.
problemStatement: Property browsing needs intuitive search and visual presentation.
architecture: Static site with JavaScript interactivity, deployed on Vercel.

title: Product Management System (C)
description: Console-based product management system with file handling in C.
longDescription: My first major programming project — a complete product management system in C featuring CRUD operations, file persistence, and structured data management.
problemStatement: Learning fundamental programming concepts through a practical inventory system.
architecture: Console application with file I/O for data persistence using C structures and switch-case menu system.

title: Java Password Generator
description: Secure password generator built with Java featuring customizable options.
longDescription: A Java application for generating secure passwords with configurable length, character sets, and strength indicators.
problemStatement: Users need a simple tool to generate strong, customizable passwords.
architecture: Java Swing GUI with secure random number generation.
